description: Per-episode bread/plate geometry and layout measured from the released HumanEgo serve_bread preprocessing outputs (triangulated contour keypoints, DINO+SAM2 masks, MPS SLAM poses and semidense points). Frame H: origin = head-camera optical centre dropped onto the support plane, x = camera heading (optical axis projected horizontally), y = left, z = up (same convention as the simulator world). Lengths in metres in per-episode records; cm/deg in summaries.

excluded.mps_serve_bread_033_vrs: bread contour triangulation implausible (horizontal extent 19.6 cm, contour 7 cm above the fitted support); excluded from all statistics

notes.mps_serve_bread_060_vrs: per-frame aria_cam_rgb.json/config/rgb.png re-extracted at 1920x1080 (f=960) after preprocessing; tracks, masks and training_data.json are 640x480 f=320 (used here; reprojection 1.1 px). Included.
notes.mps_serve_bread_000_vrs: held-out eval session in the released training config (train = 001-060).
